name: Hanabana no Omohi...
source:
Main character is a student in a mountainous town rich in nature. As grandfather gets hospitalized, protagonist decides to leave for the city where his father with remarriage partner live. His female childhood friend decides to follow him. His life starts to change drastically in the new family surrounded by girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是自然资源丰富的山间城镇里的一名学生。祖父住院后，他决定前往城市，与父亲及父亲的再婚对象共同生活。青梅竹马也决定随他同行。在这个被少女环绕的新家庭中，他的人生开始发生剧烈变化。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
